note: v2.9 records carry a signature but no signer_pubkey, so stripping the block moves no digest and the anchored head still matches. Re-signing in place is impossible (record_hash would move and break every prev_hash after it; the signer's key is not on this machine). This record names, inside its own hashed body, which record hash is supposed to carry which pubkey — verify() then treats a missing or mismatched signature on those records as an error. It relocates the exposure rather than retiring it: truncate this record away and local verification is quiet again, which is exactly what expect_head/expect_min_len and the tree anchor are for. Unsigned on purpose: the detection comes from the hash chain covering `attests`, not from a signature on this record, and minting a fresh key here would only add an identity nobody has established.
